name: registry
description: Reads, writes, deletes, or lists Windows Registry keys and values (HKCU, HKLM, HKCR, HKU, HKCC) with 64-bit/32-bit view awareness.

mode.description: Registry operation mode: 'get' reads a value, 'set' creates/updates, 'delete_value' removes a value, 'delete_key' removes a key, 'list' enumerates subkeys and values.

name.description: Value name. Empty string or omit for the (Default) value.

value.description: Value data to write (required for mode='set').

view64.description: Whether to access the 64-bit registry view (KEY_WOW64_64KEY). Defaults to true.
